q: 我___球衣洗干净了。
zh: 我把球衣洗干净了。
py: wǒ bǎ qiú yī xǐ gān jìng le
en: I washed the jersey clean.
why: A specific object plus a result (洗干净) is the 把 pattern: 把 + object before the verb. 被 would make the jersey the one doing the washing, and 在 and 对 cannot join a subject to an object this way.

q: 哥哥不小心把玻璃踢___了。
zh: 哥哥不小心把玻璃踢坏了。
py: gē ge bù xiǎo xīn bǎ bō lí tī huài le
en: My brother accidentally kicked the glass and broke it.
why: The result of the kick is that the glass broke, so the result complement is 坏. 走 would mean the glass moved away, and 到 and 在 need a destination after them, which this sentence does not give.

q: 他生气地把网球拍摔___了。
zh: 他生气地把网球拍摔坏了。
py: tā shēng qì de bǎ wǎng qiú pāi shuāi huài le
en: Angrily, he smashed his tennis racket and broke it.
why: 摔坏 gives the result of the throw: the racket is now broken. 着 and 过 are aspect markers, not results, and 给 would need a person who receives the racket.

q: 请把比赛的时间记___，别忘了。
zh: 请把比赛的时间记住，别忘了。
py: qǐng bǎ bǐ sài de shí jiān jì zhù bié wàng le
en: Please remember the match time, and do not forget it.
why: 记住 means to fix something in memory, which is what the second clause asks for. 记错 means to remember wrongly, and 记走 and 记掉 are not used in this sense.

q: 教练终于把队员们的错误动作都纠正___了。
zh: 教练终于把队员们的错误动作都纠正过来了。
py: jiào liàn zhōng yú bǎ duì yuán men de cuò wù dòng zuò dōu jiū zhèng guò lái le
en: The coach finally got all the players' wrong movements corrected.
why: 纠正过来 is the set result: bring a wrong habit back to right. 起来, 出来 and 下去 give directions that cannot be attached to 纠正 in this meaning.

q: 请把包里的球拍拿___来。
zh: 请把包里的球拍拿出来。
py: qǐng bǎ bāo lǐ de qiú pāi ná chū lái
en: Please take the racket out of the bag.
why: 拿出来 matches "out of the bag", and the object stays in front of the verb with 把. 进来 means in, 上来 up and 下来 down, which all contradict 包里.

q: 外面下雨了，快把自行车推___去吧。
zh: 外面下雨了，快把自行车推进去吧。
py: wài miàn xià yǔ le kuài bǎ zì xíng chē tuī jìn qù ba
en: It is raining outside, quick, push the bike inside.
why: Rain means the bike should go indoors, so 进 + 去. 出去 is the opposite direction, and 上去 and 起去 do not describe going into a place.

q: 比赛结束了，你把足球带___吧。
zh: 比赛结束了，你把足球带回去吧。
py: bǐ sài jié shù le nǐ bǎ zú qiú dài huí qù ba
en: The match is over, take the ball back with you.
why: 带回去 is taking something back to where it belongs, away from the speaker. 出来, 起来 and 上来 are directions of coming out or up, none of which means taking a ball home.

q: 裁判把黄牌从口袋里拿___，举了起来。
zh: 裁判把黄牌从口袋里拿出来，举了起来。
py: cái pàn bǎ huáng pái cóng kǒu dai lǐ ná chū lái jǔ le qǐ lái
en: The referee took the yellow card out of his pocket and held it up.
why: He takes the card out of the pocket, so 拿 + 出来, with the whole direction after the verb. 进去 would put it in, and 回去 and 下去 point to places the card does not go.

q: 地铁站的人太多，他好不容易才把婴儿车搬___了楼梯。
zh: 地铁站的人太多，他好不容易才把婴儿车搬下了楼梯。
py: dì tiě zhàn de rén tài duō tā hǎo bù róng yì cái bǎ yīng ér chē bān xià le lóu tī
en: The metro station was so crowded that he barely managed to carry the pram down the stairs.
why: The pram goes down the stairs, so 下 follows 搬 directly. 上 means up, and 过 and 出 mean across and out, which are not the movement described.

q: 我把自行车锁___公园门口了。
zh: 我把自行车锁在公园门口了。
py: wǒ bǎ zì xíng chē suǒ zài gōng yuán mén kǒu le
en: I locked my bike at the park entrance.
why: 锁 + 在 + place says where the bike ends up locked, with the object brought forward by 把. 给 needs a person, 成 a new form and 走 a direction, so none of them can take 公园门口.

q: 司机把我们送___了火车站。
zh: 司机把我们送到了火车站。
py: sī jī bǎ wǒ men sòng dào le huǒ chē zhàn
en: The driver took us to the train station.
why: 送 + 到 means moving someone to a destination, and 火车站 is where we arrive. 给 is for a person receiving something, 在 for where something rests, and 成 for turning into something.

q: 教练把这份名单交___队长了。
zh: 教练把这份名单交给队长了。
py: jiào liàn bǎ zhè fèn míng dān jiāo gěi duì zhǎng le
en: The coach handed this list to the captain.
why: A person who receives the thing needs 给 after 交. 到 and 在 would need a place word, and 成 would mean turning the list into the captain.

q: 他把这首英文歌翻译___了中文。
zh: 他把这首英文歌翻译成了中文。
py: tā bǎ zhè shǒu yīng wén gē fān yì chéng le zhōng wén
en: He translated this English song into Chinese.
why: 翻译成 changes one form into another, and the new form 中文 follows directly. 给 would introduce a person, and 到 and 在 would introduce a place.

q: 我们都把他___球队的灵魂。
zh: 我们都把他当作球队的灵魂。
py: wǒ men dōu bǎ tā dàng zuò qiú duì de líng hún
en: We all regard him as the soul of the team.
why: 当作 means to treat as, and the role 球队的灵魂 follows right after it. 带到 and 放在 need a place, and 送给 needs a person who receives something.

q: 你把这瓶水喝___吧，比赛前要补水。
zh: 你把这瓶水喝了吧，比赛前要补水。
py: nǐ bǎ zhè píng shuǐ hē le ba bǐ sài qián yào bǔ shuǐ
en: Drink up this bottle of water, you need to rehydrate before the match.
why: A bare 喝 cannot end a 把 clause, and 了 is the lightest ending that works when a drink is used up. 着 and 过 do not complete the action, and 在 would need a place after it.

q: 他不想要了，就把那双旧球鞋扔___。
zh: 他不想要了，就把那双旧球鞋扔了。
py: tā bù xiǎng yào le jiù bǎ nà shuāng jiù qiú xié rēng le
en: He did not want them any more, so he threw the old sneakers away.
why: 扔 gets rid of the object, so 了 alone is enough to complete the 把 clause. A bare 扔 is not allowed, 着 means ongoing, and 在 would need a place after it.

q: 请把那件球衣试___，看合不合适。
zh: 请把那件球衣试一下，看合不合适。
py: qǐng bǎ nà jiàn qiú yī shì yī xià kàn hé bù hé shì
en: Please try that jersey on and see whether it fits.
why: A request with 把 needs a light ending after the verb, and 一下 gives "try it for a moment". 着 and 过 do not complete the action, and a bare 试 is not allowed.

q: 他把今天有比赛的事忘___，所以没带球鞋。
zh: 他把今天有比赛的事忘了，所以没带球鞋。
py: tā bǎ jīn tiān yǒu bǐ sài de shì wàng le suǒ yǐ méi dài qiú xié
en: He forgot that there was a match today, so he did not bring his sneakers.
why: 忘 means the thing is lost from memory, so 了 is enough to close a 把 clause. 过 would mean having forgotten at some time, 着 does not fit, and a bare 忘 is not allowed.

q: 我___把球拍带来，今天不能打球了。
zh: 我没把球拍带来，今天不能打球了。
py: wǒ méi bǎ qiú pāi dài lái jīn tiān bù néng dǎ qiú le
en: I did not bring my racket, so I cannot play today.
why: 没 goes before 把 and says the action did not happen. 不 would mean refusing or a habit, 别 is a command, and 就 does not negate anything.

q: 打球的时候，___把手机放在场边。
zh: 打球的时候，别把手机放在场边。
py: dǎ qiú de shí hou bié bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài chǎng biān
en: Do not leave your phone at the side of the court while you play.
why: 别 before 把 gives a "don't" command, and the English cue is an instruction. 没 would report something that did not happen, and 不是 and 未 do not fit a command.

q: 你___把地图带上，免得迷路。
zh: 你最好把地图带上，免得迷路。
py: nǐ zuì hǎo bǎ dì tú dài shàng miǎn de mí lù
en: You had better take the map with you so you do not get lost.
why: 最好 is a modal-like adverb and, like all of them, it goes before 把. 因为 and 虽然 are conjunctions that would not make advice, and 刚才 would put the action in the past.

q: 地铁里人很多，请___把大背包放在地上。
zh: 地铁里人很多，请不要把大背包放在地上。
py: dì tiě lǐ rén hěn duō qǐng bú yào bǎ dà bēi bāo fàng zài dì shàng
en: The metro is crowded, so please do not put your big backpack on the floor.
why: 不要 before 把 forbids the action. 没有 reports something that did not happen, 不会 predicts, and 不用 means "no need to", which does not fit a polite request.

q: 我把___买回来了，你明天就能用。
zh: 我把你要的那个新篮球买回来了，你明天就能用。
py: wǒ bǎ nǐ yào de nà ge xīn lán qiú mǎi huí lái le nǐ míng tiān jiù néng yòng
en: I have bought back the new basketball you wanted, so you can use it tomorrow.
why: The 把 object must be something we can both identify, and 你要的那个新篮球 is exactly that. 一个新篮球 would introduce a new, unspecified ball and belongs after the verb instead.

q: 他很喜欢___这个城市的夜景。
zh: 他很喜欢这个城市的夜景。
py: tā hěn xǐ huan zhè ge chéng shì de yè jǐng
en: He really likes the night view of this city.
why: 喜欢 is a feeling verb that does nothing to its object, so it takes a plain object with no 把. Inserting 把 would leave the sentence waiting for another verb.

q: 昨天我没把球鞋带回家___。
zh: 昨天我没把球鞋带回家。
py: zuó tiān wǒ méi bǎ qiú xié dài huí jiā
en: I did not take my sneakers home yesterday.
why: 没 already says the action did not happen, so 了 cannot be added at the end. The sentence stands with 没把 and the complete verb 带回家 alone.

zh: 弟弟把足球踢破了。
py: dì di bǎ zú qiú tī pò le
en: My brother kicked the football and burst it.
why: The ball goes between 把 and the verb, and the result 破 stays glued to 踢, with 了 last. Putting 足球 after 踢破了 would leave the 把 tile with nothing to do.

zh: 我把跑鞋穿坏了。
py: wǒ bǎ pǎo xié chuān huài le
en: I have worn out my running shoes.
why: The object follows 把 straight away, and 穿坏 stays together as verb plus result with 了 at the end. Splitting 坏 off from 穿 breaks the pattern.

zh: 教练把比赛场地记错了。
py: jiào liàn bǎ bǐ sài chǎng dì jì cuò le
en: The coach got the venue of the match wrong.
why: Subject, 把, the specific object, then verb plus result 记错, then 了. A 把 sentence never puts the object after the result complement.

zh: 请把球扔过来。
py: qǐng bǎ qiú rēng guò lái
en: Please throw the ball over here.
why: The object 球 comes directly after 把 and the verb with its direction (扔过来) follows as one block. The object cannot sit inside or after the direction.

zh: 他把自行车骑回去了。
py: tā bǎ zì xíng chē qí huí qù le
en: He rode the bike back.
why: 把 + object, then verb plus the full direction 骑回去, then 了. Moving 自行车 behind 骑回去 would put the object after the direction, which 把 does not allow.

zh: 服务员把菜端上来了。
py: fú wù yuán bǎ cài duān shàng lái le
en: The waiter brought the dishes out to the table.
why: The dishes go after 把, and 端上来 is a single verb-plus-direction block that ends the clause before 了. The direction cannot be separated from the verb.

zh: 比赛一结束，他就把球鞋脱下来了。
py: bǐ sài yī jié shù tā jiù bǎ qiú xié tuō xià lái le
en: As soon as the match ended, he took off his sneakers.
why: The time clause stands first, and 把 comes after 就 with the object in front of the verb 脱下来. 就 modifies the whole 把 phrase, so it cannot come between 把 and the object.

zh: 我把车停在路边了。
py: wǒ bǎ chē tíng zài lù biān le
en: I parked the car by the roadside.
why: 停在 + place says where the car ends up, so the car must go forward with 把. 路边 comes right after 停在, with nothing in between.

zh: 他把钥匙放在口袋里了。
py: tā bǎ yào shi fàng zài kǒu dai lǐ le
en: He put the keys in his pocket.
why: The object goes after 把, then 放在 + place. 放在 must be followed directly by 口袋里, and 钥匙 cannot be put after 放在.

zh: 司机把我们送到了地铁站。
py: sī jī bǎ wǒ men sòng dào le dì tiě zhàn
en: The driver took us to the metro station.
why: 把 + 我们 stands before the verb, and 送到 + destination ends the clause. The destination cannot come between 把 and the verb.

zh: 请把这封信交给那位工作人员。
py: qǐng bǎ zhè fēng xìn jiāo gěi nà wèi gōng zuò rén yuán
en: Please hand this letter to that staff member.
why: 交给 + person needs the specific letter brought forward with 把. The receiver follows 交给 directly.

zh: 他把那本旅行指南翻译成了英文。
py: tā bǎ nà běn lǚ xíng zhǐ nán fān yì chéng le yīng wén
en: He translated that travel guide into English.
why: 翻译成 must be followed by the new form 英文, so the thing translated goes before the verb with 把. The 了 can sit before or after 英文.

zh: 他把那条狗牵到了公园里。
py: tā bǎ nà tiáo gǒu qiān dào le gōng yuán lǐ
en: He led the dog to the park.
why: 牵到 + place says where the dog is taken, so the dog goes before the verb with 把. The destination 公园里 stays right after 牵到.

zh: 妈妈没把钱包放在包里。
py: mā ma méi bǎ qián bāo fàng zài bāo lǐ
en: Mum did not put the wallet in the bag.
why: 没 goes before 把, not before the verb, and there is no 了 after 没. 放在包里 stays together as the end of the clause.

zh: 不要把垃圾扔在球场上。
py: bú yào bǎ lā jī rēng zài qiú chǎng shàng
en: Do not throw rubbish on the court.
why: 不要 comes before 把, and 扔在 is followed straight away by the place. 不要 cannot be moved between the object and 扔在.

zh: 你能把这张地图借给我吗？
py: nǐ néng bǎ zhè zhāng dì tú jiè gěi wǒ ma
en: Can you lend me this map?
why: The modal 能 comes before 把, and 吗 closes the question. 借给 + 我 forms one block after the object, so the object cannot follow 借给.

zh: 我马上把球鞋换好。
py: wǒ mǎ shàng bǎ qiú xié huàn hǎo
en: I will get my sneakers changed right away.
why: The adverb 马上 goes before 把, not before 换好. Placing it between 球鞋 and 换好 is the classic mistake.

zh: 教练还没把名单交给我们。
py: jiào liàn hái méi bǎ míng dān jiāo gěi wǒ men
en: The coach still has not handed the list to us.
why: 还没 stands before 把 as one unit, and 交给 + person follows the object. Negation cannot move to the verb.

zh: 我想把周末的比赛录下来。
py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhōu mò de bǐ sài lù xià lái
en: I want to record the weekend match.
why: The modal 想 comes before 把, and the object 周末的比赛 goes in front of 录下来. 想 cannot be put between the object and the verb.

zh: 你应该把这条路线记清楚。
py: nǐ yīng gāi bǎ zhè tiáo lù xiàn jì qīng chu
en: You should memorise this route properly.
why: The modal 应该 sits before 把, and the verb with its result 记清楚 comes last. 应该 between 这条路线 and 记清楚 would be wrong.

zh: 你把跑鞋擦一擦。
py: nǐ bǎ pǎo xié cā yi cā
en: Give your running shoes a wipe.
why: A bare 擦 is not allowed after 把, so the verb is doubled as 擦一擦. The object goes right after 把.

zh: 请把球场打扫一下。
py: qǐng bǎ qiú chǎng dǎ sǎo yī xià
en: Please tidy up the court a bit.
why: 打扫 needs 一下 after it to complete the 把 clause. The object 球场 stays between 把 and the verb.

zh: 他把外套脱了。
py: tā bǎ wài tào tuō le
en: He took off his coat.
why: 脱 removes the object, so 了 alone completes the 把 clause. The object must come before 脱, and a bare 脱 would be incomplete.

zh: 我买了一双新球鞋。
py: wǒ mǎi le yī shuāng xīn qiú xié
en: I bought a pair of new sneakers.
why: "A pair of new sneakers" is new information, not something the listener can identify, so it stays after the verb. 把 needs a specific object, so the extra tile 把 is not used.

zh: 我看不懂这张地图。
py: wǒ kàn bù dǒng zhè zhāng dì tú
en: I cannot understand this map.
why: A "can't manage" complement (看不懂) never combines with 把, so the object stays after the verb. The extra 把 tile would make the sentence wrong.

src: 他踢坏了邻居的窗户。
src_py: tā tī huài le lín jū de chuāng hu
zh: 他把邻居的窗户踢坏了。
py: tā bǎ lín jū de chuāng hu tī huài le
en: He kicked the neighbour's window and broke it.
why: 把 moves the object in front of the verb, and 踢坏 keeps its result with 了 at the end.

src: 我打完了这场比赛。
src_py: wǒ dǎ wán le zhè chǎng bǐ sài
zh: 我把这场比赛打完了。
py: wǒ bǎ zhè chǎng bǐ sài dǎ wán le
en: I finished playing this match.
why: The object 这场比赛 goes between 把 and the verb, and 打完 stays together with 了 after it.

src: 他看清楚了路牌上的字。
src_py: tā kàn qīng chu le lù pái shàng de zì
zh: 他把路牌上的字看清楚了。
py: tā bǎ lù pái shàng de zì kàn qīng chu le
en: He read the words on the street sign clearly.
why: Even a perception verb takes 把 when a real result (清楚) follows. The object goes before 看清楚 and 了 closes the clause.

src: 我把那本旅游书看完了。
src_py: wǒ bǎ nà běn lǚ yóu shū kàn wán le
zh: 我看完了那本旅游书。
py: wǒ kàn wán le nà běn lǚ yóu shū
en: I finished that travel book.
why: Without 把 the object returns to its normal place after the verb and its result, and 了 follows the result: 看完了那本旅游书.

src: 妹妹弄丢了我的球拍，所以我很生气。
src_py: mèi mei nòng diū le wǒ de qiú pāi suǒ yǐ wǒ hěn shēng qì
task: Rewrite the first clause with 把.
zh: 妹妹把我的球拍弄丢了，所以我很生气。
py: mèi mei bǎ wǒ de qiú pāi nòng diū le suǒ yǐ wǒ hěn shēng qì
en: My little sister lost my racket, so I am angry.
why: The first clause becomes 妹妹把我的球拍弄丢了, with the object before 弄丢 and 了 after it. The second clause is unchanged.

src: 请拿出球来。
src_py: qǐng ná chū qiú lái
zh: 请把球拿出来。
py: qǐng bǎ qiú ná chū lái
en: Please take the ball out.
why: With 把 the object 球 goes right after it, and the verb with its direction 拿出来 follows as one block.

src: 他带走了那个篮球。
src_py: tā dài zǒu le nà ge lán qiú
zh: 他把那个篮球带走了。
py: tā bǎ nà ge lán qiú dài zǒu le
en: He took that basketball away.
why: The specific ball goes after 把, and 带走 keeps its direction right behind the verb with 了 at the end.

src: 她拿走了我的水瓶。
src_py: tā ná zǒu le wǒ de shuǐ píng
zh: 她把我的水瓶拿走了。
py: tā bǎ wǒ de shuǐ píng ná zǒu le
en: She took my water bottle.
why: 我的水瓶 is specific, so it can follow 把, and 拿走 stays together before 了.

src: 他从背包里拿出了跑鞋。
src_py: tā cóng bēi bāo lǐ ná chū le pǎo xié
zh: 他把跑鞋从背包里拿出来了。
py: tā bǎ pǎo xié cóng bēi bāo lǐ ná chū lái le
en: He took the running shoes out of his backpack.
why: The object goes after 把 and 拿出来 ends the clause. The 从 phrase can also stand before 把.

src: 比赛结束后，所有的球门志愿者都收起来了。
src_py: bǐ sài jié shù hòu suǒ yǒu de qiú mén zhì yuàn zhě dōu shōu qǐ lái le
zh: 比赛结束后，志愿者把所有的球门都收起来了。
py: bǐ sài jié shù hòu zhì yuàn zhě bǎ suǒ yǒu de qiú mén dōu shōu qǐ lái le
en: After the match, the volunteers put all the goals away.
why: The summing-up 都 comes after the 把 object and before the verb. The time phrase can also stand after the subject.

src: 球鞋我放在门口了。
src_py: qiú xié wǒ fàng zài mén kǒu le
zh: 我把球鞋放在门口了。
py: wǒ bǎ qiú xié fàng zài mén kǒu le
en: I put my sneakers by the door.
why: The fronted object returns after 把 and the subject, followed by 放在 + place. 放在 must be followed directly by 门口.

src: 我还了朋友那本书。
src_py: wǒ hái le péng you nà běn shū
zh: 我把那本书还给了朋友。
py: wǒ bǎ nà běn shū huán gěi le péng you
en: I gave that book back to my friend.
why: The specific book goes after 把 and the receiver follows 还给. The 了 can sit before or after 朋友.

src: 那张照片他放在钱包里了。
src_py: nà zhāng zhào piān tā fàng zài qián bāo lǐ le
zh: 他把那张照片放在钱包里了。
py: tā bǎ nà zhāng zhào piān fàng zài qián bāo lǐ le
en: He put that photo in his wallet.
why: The fronted object moves back behind the subject with 把, and 放在 + place follows as one block.

src: 请把这张票交给他。
src_py: qǐng bǎ zhè zhāng piào jiāo gěi tā
zh: 请交给他这张票。
py: qǐng jiāo gěi tā zhè zhāng piào
en: Please hand him this ticket.
why: Without 把 the person goes straight after 交给 and the thing handed over follows: 请交给他这张票.

src: 他认为球场是自己的家。
src_py: tā rèn wéi qiú chǎng shì zì jǐ de jiā
task: Say he treats it as his own home, using 把.
zh: 他把球场当作自己的家。
py: tā bǎ qiú chǎng dàng zuò zì jǐ de jiā
en: He treats the pitch as his own home.
why: 把…当作… expresses treating something as something else. The object goes before 当作 and the new role follows it directly.

src: 导游带游客们到了城市中心的广场。
src_py: dǎo yóu dài yóu kè men dào le chéng shì zhōng xīn de guǎng chǎng
zh: 导游把游客们带到了城市中心的广场。
py: dǎo yóu bǎ yóu kè men dài dào le chéng shì zhōng xīn de guǎng chǎng
en: The guide took the tourists to the square in the city centre.
why: The tourists move to before the verb with 把, and 带到 + destination ends the clause. The 了 can follow 带到 or the destination.

src: 这篇比赛报道，他翻译成英文了。
src_py: zhè piān bǐ sài bào dào tā fān yì chéng yīng wén le
zh: 他把这篇比赛报道翻译成英文了。
py: tā bǎ zhè piān bǐ sài bào dào fān yì chéng yīng wén le
en: He translated this match report into English.
why: The fronted object returns after the subject with 把, and 翻译成 is followed by the new form 英文. The 了 can sit before or after 英文.

src: 他卖了那辆旧摩托车。
src_py: tā mài le nà liàng jiù mó tuō chē
zh: 他把那辆旧摩托车卖了。
py: tā bǎ nà liàng jiù mó tuō chē mài le
en: He sold that old motorbike.
why: 卖 gets rid of its object, so 了 alone is enough after 把. The specific motorbike goes before the verb.

src: 请刷刷球鞋。
src_py: qǐng shuā shua qiú xié
task: Ask politely with 把 and a doubled verb.
zh: 请把球鞋刷一刷。
py: qǐng bǎ qiú xié shuā yī shuā
en: Please give the sneakers a scrub.
why: Rewritten with 把, the verb cannot stay bare, so it is doubled as 刷一刷. The object goes right after 把.

src: 他忘了那场比赛的时间。
src_py: tā wàng le nà chǎng bǐ sài de shí jiān
zh: 他把那场比赛的时间忘了。
py: tā bǎ nà chǎng bǐ sài de shí jiān wàng le
en: He forgot the time of that match.
why: 忘 loses the object from memory, so 了 alone completes the 把 clause. The object goes before 忘.

src: 他把地图拿出来了。
src_py: tā bǎ dì tú ná chū lái le
zh: 他没把地图拿出来。
py: tā méi bǎ dì tú ná chū lái
en: He did not take the map out.
why: 没 goes before 把, not before the verb, and 了 is dropped. 他把地图没拿出来 is the classic error.

src: 你把手机放在地上了。
src_py: nǐ bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài dì shàng le
task: Tell him not to do it.
zh: 别把手机放在地上。
py: bié bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài dì shàng
en: Do not put your phone on the floor.
why: A command is made with 别 before 把, and 了 is dropped. 别 cannot be moved to the verb.

src: 他把球队的新名单告诉我了。
src_py: tā bǎ qiú duì de xīn míng dān gào su wǒ le
zh: 他没把球队的新名单告诉我。
py: tā méi bǎ qiú duì de xīn míng dān gào su wǒ
en: He did not tell me the team's new list.
why: 没 stands before 把 and 了 disappears. The negator never goes between the object and the verb.

src: 我看完这本关于游泳的书。
src_py: wǒ kàn wán zhè běn guān yú yóu yǒng de shū
task: Say you want to do it, using 把.
zh: 我想把这本关于游泳的书看完。
py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè běn guān yú yóu yǒng de shū kàn wán
en: I want to finish this book about swimming.
why: The modal 想 comes before 把, and the object goes in front of 看完. 了 is not used because the action has not happened yet.

src: 我买好了去体育馆的票。
src_py: wǒ mǎi hǎo le qù tǐ yù guǎn de piào
task: Say you already did it, using 把.
zh: 我已经把去体育馆的票买好了。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ qù tǐ yù guǎn de piào mǎi hǎo le
en: I have already bought the tickets to the stadium.
why: 已经 goes before 把, the object before the verb, and 买好了 keeps its result and 了 at the end.

src: 他把借的足球还给我了。
src_py: tā bǎ jiè de zú qiú huán gěi wǒ le
zh: 他还没把借的足球还给我。
py: tā hái méi bǎ jiè de zú qiú huán gěi wǒ
en: He still has not given the football he borrowed back to me.
why: 还没 goes before 把 as a unit, and 了 is dropped. 还给 + person follows the object.

src: 我昨天看完了那本关于足球的书。
src_py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn wán le nà běn guān yú zú qiú de shū
zh: 我昨天把那本关于足球的书看完了。
py: wǒ zuó tiān bǎ nà běn guān yú zú qiú de shū kàn wán le
en: I finished that book about football yesterday.
why: The specific book (那本…) can go after 把. The time word can come before or after the subject, but must precede 把.

src: 我把那杯果汁喝完了。
src_py: wǒ bǎ nà bēi guǒ zhī hē wán le
task: Say it was two glasses of juice, in plain order.
zh: 我喝完了两杯果汁。
py: wǒ hē wán le liǎng bēi guǒ zhī
en: I finished two glasses of juice.
why: "Two glasses of juice" is a new counted object, so it follows the verb instead of 把.

src: 我今天能把这些路线图看完。
src_py: wǒ jīn tiān néng bǎ zhè xiē lù xiàn tú kàn wán
task: Say you cannot finish them today.
zh: 我今天看不完这些路线图。
py: wǒ jīn tiān kàn bù wán zhè xiē lù xiàn tú
en: I cannot finish looking at these route maps today.
why: A "can't manage" complement (看不完) never combines with 把, so the object goes after the verb.

src: 他把那场比赛看完了。
src_py: tā bǎ nà chǎng bǐ sài kàn wán le
task: Say he is watching it right now, with no 把.
zh: 他正在看那场比赛。
py: tā zhèng zài kàn nà chǎng bǐ sài
en: He is watching that match right now.
why: An action in progress has no finished result for 把 to build on, so use plain 正在 + verb + object.

s_py: wǒ bǎ zú qiú hěn xǐ huan
zh: 我很喜欢足球。
py: wǒ hěn xǐ huan zú qiú
en: I really like football.
why: 喜欢 does nothing to its object, so it never takes 把. The plain order 我很喜欢足球 is the only option.

s: 我昨天在公园把小王看见了。
s_py: wǒ zuó tiān zài gōng yuán bǎ xiǎo wáng kàn jiàn le
zh: 我昨天在公园看见小王了。
py: wǒ zuó tiān zài gōng yuán kàn jiàn xiǎo wáng le
en: I saw Xiao Wang in the park yesterday.
why: 看见 only records a perception and leaves 小王 unchanged, so 把 is not possible. Plain SVO with 了 at the end is correct.

s: 我把教练的电话号码忘了。
zh: 我把教练的电话号码忘了。
py: wǒ bǎ jiào liàn de diàn huà hào mǎ wàng le
en: I forgot the coach's phone number.
why: 忘 is a mental verb, but it does take 把 because the thing is lost, and 了 completes the clause. Do not reject it just for being a mental verb.

s: 我把教练说的话听清楚了。
zh: 我把教练说的话听清楚了。
py: wǒ bǎ jiào liàn shuō de huà tīng qīng chu le
en: I heard what the coach said clearly.
why: 听 normally resists 把, but here a real result 清楚 follows, so the words are dealt with and 把 is fine.

s_py: tā bǎ běi jīng qù le
zh: 他去了北京。
py: tā qù le běi jīng
en: He went to Beijing.
why: 去 is a movement verb that does not act on its object, so 把 cannot be used. 北京 is just where he went.

s_py: wǒ bǎ zhè ge chéng shì hěn shú xī
zh: 我很熟悉这个城市。
py: wǒ hěn shú xī zhè ge chéng shì
en: I know this city very well.
why: 熟悉 describes a state of knowing and does nothing to the city, so 把 is impossible. Plain SVO is the only form.

s_py: wǒ bǎ shuǐ hú méi dài lái
zh: 我没把水壶带来。
py: wǒ méi bǎ shuǐ hú dài lái
en: I did not bring my water bottle.
why: 没 must stand before 把, not between the object and the verb. 没把球拍带来 is the correct order.

s_py: nǐ bǎ chē kě yǐ tíng zài lù biān
zh: 你可以把车停在路边。
py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ chē tíng zài lù biān
en: You can park the car by the roadside.
why: Modal verbs such as 可以 stand before 把. Putting 可以 after the object breaks the 把 pattern.

zh: 别把雨伞忘在地铁里。
py: bié bǎ yǔ sǎn wàng zài dì tiě lǐ
en: Do not leave your umbrella on the metro.
why: 别 stands before 把, and 忘在地铁里 gives the place where the umbrella ends up left. Nothing is wrong with it.

s_py: tā bǎ chē yǐ jīng kāi zǒu le
zh: 他已经把车开走了。
py: tā yǐ jīng bǎ chē kāi zǒu le
en: He has already driven the car away.
why: Time adverbs such as 已经 go before 把, never after the object. 已经把车开走了 is correct.

s: 我昨天把桌上那杯咖啡喝完了。
zh: 我昨天把桌上那杯咖啡喝完了。
py: wǒ zuó tiān bǎ zhuō shàng nà bēi kā fēi hē wán le
en: I finished the cup of coffee on the table yesterday.
why: 桌上那杯咖啡 points to one identifiable cup and 喝完 gives a result, so 把 is right. A new counted object such as 一杯咖啡 would stay after the verb instead.

zh: 他把那瓶水喝完了。
py: tā bǎ nà píng shuǐ hē wán le
en: He finished that bottle of water.
why: 那瓶水 is specific and 喝完 gives a result, so the 把 sentence is fully correct.

s: 我把朋友借给我的球拍弄坏了。
zh: 我把朋友借给我的球拍弄坏了。
py: wǒ bǎ péng you jiè gěi wǒ de qiú pāi nòng huài le
en: I broke the racket my friend lent me.
why: The long modifier 朋友借给我的 makes the racket identifiable, and 弄坏了 gives a result. 把 is correct.

s_py: tā bǎ zhè tiáo lù xiàn zǒu bù wán
zh: 他走不完这条路线。
py: tā zǒu bù wán zhè tiáo lù xiàn
en: He cannot finish walking this route.
why: 走不完 says the result cannot be reached, and 把 needs a result that is reached, so they never combine.

s_py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng bǎ niú nǎi hē
zh: 我每天早上喝牛奶。
py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng hē niú nǎi
en: I drink milk every morning.
why: A daily habit has no single result to build on, and a bare 喝 after 把 is not allowed. Use plain SVO.

s: 我每个周末都在公园踢足球。
zh: 我每个周末都在公园踢足球。
py: wǒ měi gè zhōu mò dōu zài gōng yuán tī zú qiú
en: I play football in the park every weekend.
why: A habit takes plain SVO, which is what this sentence has. It would be wrong to force 把 into it.

s_py: wǒ bǎ hē wán le nà bēi chá
zh: 我把那杯茶喝完了。
py: wǒ bǎ nà bēi chá hē wán le
en: I finished that cup of tea.
why: The object goes right after 把, before the verb. Leaving 那杯茶 after 喝完了 means 把 has nothing to attach to.

s: 志愿者把搬进去了桌子。
s_py: zhì yuàn zhě bǎ bān jìn qù le zhuō zi
zh: 志愿者把桌子搬进去了。
py: zhì yuàn zhě bǎ zhuō zi bān jìn qù le
en: The volunteer carried the table inside.
why: The object must come directly after 把 and the verb with its direction follows. 搬进去 cannot come before the object, and 了 goes after the direction.

s: 我把这个电话号码写在手心上了。
zh: 我把这个电话号码写在手心上了。
py: wǒ bǎ zhè ge diàn huà hào mǎ xiě zài shǒu xīn shàng le
en: I wrote this phone number on the palm of my hand.
why: 写在 + place needs the specific number before the verb with 把, which is exactly what this sentence does.

s: 他把钱包放了在桌子上。
s_py: tā bǎ qián bāo fàng le zài zhuō zi shàng
zh: 他把钱包放在桌子上了。
py: tā bǎ qián bāo fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
en: He put his wallet on the table.
why: 放在 is a unit and nothing, not even 了, can come between 放 and 在. 了 goes after the whole phrase.
